text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the existing southbound left turn prohibition, at all times, at the intersection of The Kingsway and Lambeth Road. The intersection has been reconstructed and now allows for all movements. The left turn prohibition is no longer required.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing southbound left turn prohibition in effect at all times, at The Kingsway and the ramp from Royal York Road (north of Canterbury Road).
